lines: I should get back to the sheep before they find trouble.
I should return to sorting fleece while it is still soft.
There is wool to card and thread to spin.
I promised a neighbor a new piece before moonrise.
The gate needs checking before I can settle for the evening.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to counting heads and finding the stragglers.
I have a loom set up and waiting on me.
The little ones need a shepherd's eye.
I should head out and make sure everyone is still with the flock.
Time to tend the flock and keep things calm.
I had better check the lower pasture before the light goes.
The evening count will not do itself.
One of the lambs has learned how to worry me from a distance.
I left a length of blue wool soaking. I should see what color it became.
The west fence was leaning this morning. I need to set it straight.
Rain is coming, and the flock still needs bringing under cover.
I can hear the loom calling. It sounds exactly like unfinished work.
I should shake the burrs from today's fleece before they settle in.
Someone has to make sure the hay stays dry tonight.
I will leave you to it. The sheep have been quiet for too long.
